name: ebenezer
description: Ebenezer: Telegram bot + scheduler on Supabase Edge Functions

scripts.bot:dev: supabase status -o env --override-name api.url=SUPABASE_URL --override-name auth.service_role_key=SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY > supabase/.temp/local.env && deno run --allow-net --allow-env --config supabase/functions/deno.json --env-file=supabase/.temp/local.env --env-file=supabase/functions/.env scripts/dev-bot.ts
scripts.dev:due: supabase status -o env --override-name api.url=SUPABASE_URL --override-name auth.service_role_key=SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY > supabase/.temp/local.env && deno run --allow-net --allow-env --config supabase/functions/deno.json --env-file=supabase/.temp/local.env scripts/dev-due.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:db
scripts.check: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/*/index.ts scripts/*.ts && deno lint --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions scripts && deno fmt --check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions scripts
